data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Gardos', meaning guardian, protector, or watchman. The name Garda carries the meaning “Guardian, Protector” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Garda usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing protection, courage, and faith.
data.etymology: Garda belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Garda total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Garda has been historically associated with a body of water in Ireland, named after the Irish goddess, Gar, a water goddess. It has also been used as a surname among Europeans. Through this, Garda represents protection and connection to nature and the ancient Celtic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Garda holds deep spiritual significance as it highlights the importance of protection, especially in Christian cultural context. It can serve as a reminder of God’s protection, and also our responsibility to protect and serve those around us in his name. Furthermore, it echoes the biblical belief in God as our protector and the source of true security.
